articles.title: ET Exclusive: Adani eyes controlling stake in UK's Associated British Ports
articles.original_title: ET Exclusive: Adani eyes controlling stake in UK's Associated British Ports
articles.description: Adani Ports is weighing a bid for Associated British Ports in the UK. This acquisition would expand Gautam Adani's port empire significantly. Two Canadian pension funds are selling their controlling stake in Associated British Ports. Associated British Ports owns and operates twenty-one key ports across the United Kingdom. The company is also a partner for the offshore wind industry.
